questions.question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct regarding the stratosphere?

options.text: It extends up to a height of 50 km.
It contains a layer of ozone gas.
This layer is almost free from clouds.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The statement "It lies above the mesosphere" **is incorrect when referring to the stratosphere.
 
• The stratosphere is actually located above the troposphere, which is the lowest layer of the **Earth's atmosphere.**
 
• The stratosphere extends from about 10 to 50 kilometers (6 to 31 miles) above the Earth's surface. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** The Earth's atmosphere is divided into five primary layers based on temperature changes with increasing altitude. **From the bottom to the top, these layers are:

 
 
• **Troposphere:** This is the lowest layer of the atmosphere, extending from the Earth's surface up to an average altitude of about 12 kilometers (7.5 miles) at the poles and 18 kilometers (11 miles) at the equator. The troposphere is where weather phenomena occur, and it contains most of the Earth's air mass and moisture.
 
• **Stratosphere: **Above the troposphere lies the stratosphere, extending from the top of the troposphere up to approximately 50 kilometers (31 miles) in altitude. The stratosphere contains the ozone layer, which plays a crucial role in absorbing the Sun's harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation.
 
• **Mesosphere: **The mesosphere is situated above the stratosphere and extends up to around 85 kilometers (53 miles) in altitude. In this layer, temperatures decrease with increasing altitude, reaching extremely low temperatures.
 
• **Thermosphere: **The thermosphere starts above the mesosphere and extends upward to about 600 kilometers (373 miles). It is characterized by a significant increase in temperature due to the absorption of intense solar radiation. Despite the high temperatures, the thermosphere would not feel hot to human perception due to its extremely low density of particles.
 
• **Exosphere:** The exosphere is the outermost layer of the Earth's atmosphere. It begins around 600 kilometers (373 miles) above the Earth's surface and extends indefinitely into space. The exosphere consists of extremely sparse gas molecules that gradually dissipate into the vacuum of outer space.

questions.question: Which of the following is correct regarding the Private Income?

options.text: Private Income = Factor income from net domestic product accruing to the private sector + National debt interest – Net factor income from abroad + Current transfers from government + Other net transfers from the rest of the world

Private Income = Factor income from net domestic product accruing to the private sector + National debt interest + Net factor income from abroad – Current transfers from government + Other net transfers from the rest of the world

Private Income = Factor income from net domestic product accruing to the private sector + National debt interest + Net factor income from abroad + Current transfers from government + Other net transfers from the rest of the world

Private Income = Factor income from net domestic product accruing to the private sector – National debt interest + Net factor income from abroad + Current transfers from government + Other net transfers from the rest of the world

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** ​__Private Income = Factor income from net domestic product accruing to the private sector + National debt interest + Net factor income from abroad + Current transfers from government + Other net transfers from the rest of the world__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Private income is the sum of various factor and transfer incomes that are received by private sector from all sources within and **outside the country**.
 
• This private sector includes corporates as **well as households**.
 
• Thus, the formula for Private Income is as follows:
 
• Private income = Income from domestic product accruing to private sector + Net factor income from abroad + All types of transfer incomes
 
• When we subtract from this income, the amount that is paid in the form of taxes, we get Personal income which is the net income left with corporates and private individuals. 
 
• Along with corporate taxes, undistributed profit is also subtracted from private income to arrive at personal income.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct representation of a number of atoms?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**(given mass/molar mass) × Avogadro number**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here's a breakdown of the formula:

__
 
• "given mass": This refers to the mass of the substance you are considering, typically given in grams.
 
• "molar mass": This represents the molar mass of the substance, which is the mass of one mole of that substance. It is expressed in grams per mole.
 
• "Avogadro's number": This constant is denoted by "Nₐ" or "L" and has a value of approximately 6.022 × 10²³. It represents the number of particles (atoms, molecules, ions) in one mole of a substance.
 
• The correct representation of the number of atoms is (given mass/molar mass) × Avogadro number.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The formula can be understood in the following steps:

 
• 
 
Divide the given mass of the substance (in grams) by the molar mass of the substance (in grams per mole). This gives you the number of moles of the substance.

 
 
• (given mass / molar mass)
 
 
 
• 
 
Multiply the number of moles by Avogadro's number to obtain the number of atoms.

 
 
• (given mass / molar mass) × Avogadro's number
 
 

75

questions.question: The part VII of the Indian constitution has been omitted. It is related with which of the following?

options.text: States in part B of the first schedule
Armed forces in states in part A of the second schedule
Reservation for Anglo –Indian communities in parliament

questions.solution:
Correct Answer **States in part B of the first schedule**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Out of the 22 parts of the Indian Constitution that originally existed during its formation, the only part which has been deleted is Part VII.
 
• It was repealed by the Constitution (7th Amendment) Act, 1956.
 
• It dealt with the Part-B States in the Indian Union.
 
 
• At the time of Independence and during the framing of the Constitution, India consisted of three types of states. A, B and C
 
• The Part B states were former princely states or groups of princely states.
 
• The Part B states were Hyderabad, Jammu & Kashmir, Madhya Bharat, Mysore, Patiala, East Punjab States Union (Pepsu), Rajasthan, Saurashtra, and Travancore-Cochin.
 
• When all the states were reorganized on a linguistic basis through the States Reorganisation Act, 1956, Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act was also passed.
 
• This completely led to a permanent alteration of the Indian Map and very much near to the present one. Hence Part B states were completely removed.
 
• The scheme of Part A, B, and C states were completely done away with and the only classification that now remains is States and the Union Territories.
 
• Hence the Seventh Amendment deleted Part VII which dealt with Part B states now stands omitted.

questions.question: Which of the following Harappan town was located on Khadir Beyt in the Runn of Kutch and was divided into three parts?
questions.solution:

__
 
• The Harappan Civilization prospered around 4700 years ago.
 
• The cities of the Harappan Civilization flourished mainly in the valley of the river Indus and are the earliest cities in the Indian subcontinent. 
 
• These cities were located in the Punjab and Sind in Pakistan, and in Gujarat, Rajasthan, Haryana and the Punjab in India.
 
• The Harappan towns Dholvira and Lothal are located in Gujarat.
 
• Dholavira__:
 __
 
• Dholavira was located on Khadir Beyt (also spelt as Bet) in the Rann of Kutch in Gujarat, with fresh water and fertile soil.
 
• Unlike some of the other Harappan cities, which were divided into two parts, Dholavira was divided into three parts, and each piece was surrounded by massive stone walls, with entrances through gateways.

questions.question: Behind the cornea, there is a dark muscular structure called the ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**iris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Behind the cornea, there is a dark muscular structure called the **Iris**. 
 
• It is a thin annular structure of the eye.
 
• Iris is responsible for controlling the diameter and size of the pupil and thus controlling the light that enters the eye.​
 
• Layers__
 __
 
• Iris consists of two layers
 
• In front, a pigmented fibrovascular layer known as stroma
 
• A layer of pigmented epithelial cells beneath the stroma.
 
• The stroma is connected to a sphincter muscle.
 
 
 
• Iris:
 
 
• The coloured ring around the pupil of the eye is called the iris.
 
• Controls light levels inside the eye.
 
• Tiny muscles that dilate and constrict the pupil size.
 
• Divides the front of the eye from the back of the eye.
 
• Colour comes from melanin.
 
• Iris is a part of Sclerotic and choroid. 
 
 
 
• Zones__
 
 
• Pupillary zone
 
• Ciliary zone

questions.question: Which of the statements is NOT correct regarding energy?

options.text: The energy possessed by a body due to its change in position or shape is called the potential energy.
An object of mass m moving with velocity v has a kinetic energy of (mv) /2.
The gravitational potential energy of an object of mass, M raised through a height, Hfrom the earth’s surface is given by MgH.
An object in motion possesses what is known as the kinetic energy of the object.

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The kinetic energy of an object is given by the formula KE = 1/2 mv², where m is the mass of the object and v is the velocity of the object.
 
• In this formula, the velocity is squared, so kinetic energy increases with the square of the velocity.
 
• Therefore, an object moving twice as fast has four times the kinetic energy.

Hence statement 2 is incorrect.

 
• Potential energy is the stored energy an object has because of its position or state.
 
• A common example is gravitational potential energy.
 
• An object high off the ground has gravitational potential energy because it can do work as it falls to the ground.
 
• Another example is elastic potential energy stored in a stretched or compressed spring.

**Hence statement 1 is correct.**

 
• The formula for gravitational potential energy near the surface of the Earth is PE = MgH, where m is the mass of the object, g is the acceleration due to gravity (approximately 9.8 m/s² near the Earth's surface), and h is the height above the ground.
 
• So, the potential energy increases linearly with height.

Hence statement 3 is correct.

 
• An object in motion has kinetic energy because it has the capacity to do work by virtue of its motion.
 
• The amount of kinetic energy an object has depends on both its mass and how fast it's moving.
 
• As I mentioned in statement 2, the formula for kinetic energy is 1/2 mv².

**Hence statement 4 is correct.**
